note: Verifies the '2026-07-28 MCP spec goes stateless' changelog claims against the protocol's own machine-readable schema.json, symbol by symbol. For a fixed pair of committed/pinned schema revisions the verdict is deterministic: a $defs symbol is either present or absent. Source of truth: probe-result.json.

assertion_summary.meaning: Every one of the 20 changelog claims tied to a concrete JSON-RPC type matched the schema: the REMOVED types are gone from draft and the ADDED types are present.

removed_verified.claim: Statelessness + session teardown: the handshake and session-scoped RPCs are removed.
symbols: ServerRequest (server-initiated requests replaced by MRTR, SEP-2322)
CreateTaskResult / ListTasksRequest / GetTaskRequest / Task (Tasks moved from core to the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension, SEP-2663)

added_verified.claim: New stateless machinery: up-front discovery, cacheable results, single subscription stream, multi round-trip requests, explicit error types.
symbols: DiscoverRequest / DiscoverResult (server/discover, up-front version negotiation, SEP-2575)

not_measured.runtime_interop: Schema presence/absence is NOT runtime behavior. That InitializeRequest disappeared from the schema is verified; that real servers/SDKs actually interoperate handshake-free end-to-end is NOT exercised here (SDK Tier-1 support is cited).
not_measured.auth_hardening: RFC 9207 iss validation and other auth hardening: confirmed to exist in the doc/schema only, runtime not exercised.
not_measured.mcp_apps_sandbox: MCP Apps sandbox iframe: doc/schema existence only.
not_measured.performance: Claims about running behind a round-robin load balancer and tools/list caching are the spec's design intent, cited — NOT a load measurement.

honest_limit.moving_target: The draft schema is mutable. schema/draft/schema.json kept changing until the 2026-07-28 publish, and after publish 'draft' advances to the next revision. The committed probe-result.json is the 2026-07-27 snapshot; re-fetching via run.sh pulls whatever draft is current, so the draft-axis symbol set may differ. That drift is expected and is itself part of the point. The 2025-11-25 axis is frozen and reproducible.

cited_not_measured.source: MCP blog: The 2026-07-28 MCP Specification Release Candidate

cited_not_measured.claim: Per-SEP rationale (SEP-2575 statelessness, SEP-2322 MRTR, SEP-2663 Tasks-as-extension, SEP-2549 cacheability, SEP-2243 header enforcement).
